utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all, you alright? Monday 28 September, let's get through it. Quick stand-up and then crack on.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Morning. There's a birthday cake in the office by the way, so, uh, if anyone's pretending to diet, bad luck.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Already doomed then.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Was gonna say, after I saw someone's new car in the car park, I thought that was the exciting news, but apparently it's cake.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Cake beats finance agreement, to be fair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, focus, children. Any safety stuff first?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Nothing urgent overnight. And just so nobody puts it on today's list, I already swapped the filter on the GT2 water valve yesterday, so that's done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, noted, that's closed out, not for today.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Same here, I tested the line 2 interlock yesterday and it's all fine now, so that's not a job for this morning either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, cheers Jamie.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Observation only from nights, I noticed the trucks was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Didn't develop into anything.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, similar on process, I noticed the line 1 mould temp was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down, so just keep an eye on it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I've got one on line two. The pick and place on two needs a proper stop if we're going to get anything sensible done. Aisha can't really sort the downtime with production though, that's more HSE and planning side, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I can pick that up. I'll schedule downtime for the pick and place on two with production tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, so Grace has got that, tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: On access, separate one, I still can't get to the stretch wrapper until production gives us a window, so that's blocked. Just flagging, not asking for a fresh job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, blocked on production window, understood.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: While we're on kit, the filter on the IM1 hydraulic unit wants swapping. It was sort of with me, but I'm tied up on PMs and I won't hit it by today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I can take that. I'll swap the filter on the IM1 hydraulic unit today at 2pm, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one. Marcus taking IM1 hydraulic unit, today at 2pm, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: That helps, cheers.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything on permits, isolations, that sort of thing?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: The line 1 TCU paperwork still needs the final lock-out tag-out sign-off, doesn't it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah. I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the line 1 TCU next week; that one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Bit contradictory that, next week and straight away.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I know how that sounds. I mean it's the first thing when that job window opens next week. It's safety critical, so we're not letting it drift.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fair.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: On planning bits, we were going to replace the belt on the air compressor but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good shout, cancelled then, not for this week.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I've also got admin stuff. I'll send the shift handover report round at half two, needs doing this week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ta. Put me on the cc for that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team at half two, needs doing this week.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: At the same half two?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Well, organise it at half two, not run the full thing at half two. Before you all start.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Shame, was hoping for a toolbox talk over cake.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'd attend that, to be fair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Grace, anything else from compliance?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, no rush, but I'll sort the training records for the new starters on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, training records on Friday, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace Liu, can you run the monthly fire alarm test? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, okay, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: What about the water system? Last sample results were a bit all over the place.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, we do need to book a contractor to look at the water system next week, not an emergency but don't let it slip. Who can take that?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not me this week, I'm snowed under with stores counts.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I can't add that as well today, if I'm honest.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I've got zero contractor access stuff, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Same, no capacity.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Alright, leave that open then. It needs doing next week, not an emergency but don't let it slip, but nobody's taking it right this second.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: We'll need to revisit it tomorrow then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: One from me, no rush, I'll order spare parts for the CV01 this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: If you drop me the part numbers I'll make sure stores doesn't reject anything daft.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, will do.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: On the pick and place on two, Grace, you'll need production's blessing from Bev's side probably.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I know. I'll speak to production and schedule downtime for the pick and place on two with production tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, just make sure they don't suddenly call it impossible.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: They will, and then I'll ask again.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Standard.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: For IM1 hydraulic unit, do we know if the filter's actually in stores?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Pretty sure, yeah. I saw one on the shelf Friday. If it's vanished, shout, but as of now you should be okay.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Fine. Then yeah, I'll swap the filter on the IM1 hydraulic unit today at 2pm, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Anything else mechanical from nights? Nothing major from me apart from that warm trucks note.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, just the stretch wrapper access issue, and that's still waiting on production. Not a new ask.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: After this I'll check the alarm test sheet as well, just so I've got the latest version before I run the monthly fire alarm test.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, fine.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And Sarah, with the CV01, if procurement moans about lead time again, tell them it's not urgent-urgent, right?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. No rush, but I'll order spare parts for the CV01 this afternoon so it's moving.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Do we need anything minuted on line 1 TCU beyond Sarah owning it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just that I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the line 1 TCU next week; that one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I've got that noted.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sounds good.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quick recap then. Grace has the pick and place on two downtime tomorrow morning, plus handover report at half two, training records on Friday, and the monthly fire alarm test. Marcus has IM1 hydraulic unit filter today at 2pm, normal priority. Jamie's organising the toolbox talk for the team at half two. I've got the line 1 TCU lock-out tag-out sign-off next week, safety critical, and I'll order spare parts for the CV01 this afternoon. Water system contractor still open, nobody yet.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's everything from me.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: All good.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, cake?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: After you've done some work, Tomasz. Cheers everyone.
